newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Hui Shung doubles Thursday soy/corn tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Hui Shung doubles Thursday soy/corn tender.

text.p: Taiwan's Hui Shung Group will expand Thursday's tender to 109,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans and corn, doubling its initial plan for a 54,500-tonne tender, traders said on Wednesday.
The additional shipment specification calls for 38,500 tonnes of U.S. No.2 soybeans and 16,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 corn, traders said.

On Tuesday, Hui Sheng informed traders of its intention to tender on Thursday for a virtually identical shipment of 38,500 tonnes of U.S. No.2 soybeans and 16,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 corn, traders said.
The shipments differ only in their shipping specifications.

When asked about the unusual double tender, local traders expressed doubt that Hui Shung would go through with purchase of both shipments, explaining that to do so would strain or exceed the group's grain handling capacity.
Hui Shung executives declined to comment.
The Hui Shung Group includes Hui Shung Agriculture and Food Corp, Eagle Food Industry and Charoen Pokphand.
